PUNCHCONSTRUCT_PUNCH_OFF.pages.INITIAL.d:
Two [gold]Punch Constructs[/gold] of your model are beating on each other, treasure scattered at their feet.

Seeing one of their own, they each shuffle half a step aside and make room for you.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_PUNCH_OFF.pages.NAB.descr:
You bump fists with them and casually pick up a relic.

They register their objection with a right hook.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_PUNCH_OFF.pages.I_CAN_TAK:
You signal them and raise both fists.

The two constructs bump fists and come at you side by side.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_SPIRALING_WHIRLPOOL.pages:
Water curls around your gloves.

You memorize the force of it and carry it away from the spring.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_AMALGAMATOR.pages.INITIAL:
[b][jitter]Clank! Clank!! CLANG!!![/jitter][/b]

The workshop door bursts open. A six-armed smith sizes up your gloves.

"Offense and defense both? Not bad. But it could use another round at the anvil."
Remove [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Small Waves[/gold] and add an [gold]Iron Wave[/gold] to your deck.
[gold]Transform[/gold] an [gold]Iron Wave[/gold] into [gold]Scorching Iron Wave[/gold] and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_AMALGAMATOR.pages.COMBINE:
[b][jitter]Clang! Clang!! CLANG!!![/jitter][/b]

Two Waves merge into one blow beneath the hammer.

The smith puts his hammer away, satisfied.

[b][jitter]Clang! Clang!! CLANG!!![/jitter][/b]

An iron blade is drawn from the furnace, its edge still running with red heat.

"While it's hot."
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.d:
A warrior is busy swatting a swarm of bugs. The insecticide doesn't seem to be working.

You work your arms and settle into a familiar stance.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_BUGSLAYER.pages.INITIAL.o: Add a [gold]Quick Punch[/gold] to your deck.
Add a [gold]One-Two Punch[/gold] to your deck.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_BUGSLAYER.pages.QUICK.des:
One punch.

There is a new fist print in the wall, and a few fewer bugs.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_BUGSLAYER.pages.COMBINATI:
The first punch scatters the swarm; the second lands right behind it.

The warrior quietly sets down the insecticide.
PUNCHCONSTRUCT_BUGSLAYER.pages.GUARD.des:
You raise both arms.

The swarm hits your gloves and rains down in a crackling heap.
